ACTION_EFFECTS_5E.Settings.MovementEnabl: Enables the Action Effects 5E movement transaction and relationship foundation. Processing exits immediately when no registered feature is interested in a movement.
ACTION_EFFECTS_5E.Settings.OverlapPolicy: Controls the default owner when Action Effects 5E, Chris's Premades, or Gambit's Premades could automate the same feature. Future releases will add per-subsystem ownership settings.
Writes additional Action Effects 5E diagnostics to the browser console.
ACTION_EFFECTS_5E.Settings.CaptureDiagno: Records up to 50 recent movement transactions for development. Leave disabled during normal play for the lowest overhead.
